policy: Canonical features are rebuilt only from maintained GIS/aerial interpretation and bounded public-provider snapshots. User-supplied KML/KMZ is indicative comparison evidence only and contributes zero parcel, site, bed, or plant features. Provider roofprints use representative-point parcel membership; crossing linear and areal layers must use true intersection plus clipping before any future promotion.

reviewEvidence.notes: The archive is intentionally preserved unchanged. Its raster overlay and hand-drawn vectors may reveal review questions, but neither geometry nor labels enter the canonical builder.

structurePromotion.selectionMethod: representative point within canonical parcel polygon
structurePromotion.aerialRetracePolicy: These three named roof envelopes use the reviewed 2025 orthophoto trace rather than the 2012 provider roofprint. Preserve the superseded provider geometry and source vintage in provenance; do not shift other features.
